version.changelog:
Initial release: Interactive business and value proposition canvas generator using the Strategyzer methodology.

- Guides users through structured business modeling with customer jobs, pains, gains, and product fit analysis.
- Generates up to four markdown documents: Value Proposition Canvas, Business Model Canvas, Test/Learning Cards, and Executive Summary.
- Includes detailed canvas-building phases, fit assessment, external environment mapping, and output formatting.
- Designed for use in startup planning, business evaluation, or commercialization strategy development.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: business-canvas
Version: 1.0.0

The business-canvas skill is a legitimate tool designed to guide users through the Strategyzer business modeling framework. It operates by reading project documentation (e.g., README, AGENTS.md) to gather context and generating structured markdown reports within the 'docs/business/' directory. There are no indicators of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized command execution; all behaviors are strictly aligned with its stated purpose of business analysis and validation.

llm.summary: The skill's instructions, required inputs, and outputs are coherent with a Business Model / Value Proposition Canvas generator that reads the project repo and writes canvas files into docs/business/.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match SKILL.md behavior: the skill is intended to analyze a product/repo and produce business-model documents. Requested actions (read project README/AGENTS.md/codebase and write docs to docs/business/) are reasonable for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions explicitly instruct the agent to read repository files (README, AGENTS.md, product docs, codebase) and to infer features. This is appropriate for generating canvases but is broad: the agent may scan any repo files. No instructions request environment variables or external endpoints. Recommend limiting the workspace or confirming which files the agent should access.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files. Nothing is written to disk by an installer; only runtime behavior is in SKILL.md, which is low-risk from an install perspective.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. Its file reads/writes are limited to the project workspace, which is proportional to its stated function.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and normal autonomous invocation. The skill will create/modify files under docs/business/ in the project root — expected for a document-generator but means it will change repository contents; review changes before committing or pushing.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent for generating business canvases from your repository. Before running it: (1) Confirm which repository files it may read (README, AGENTS.md, other docs) to avoid exposing sensitive notes or credentials; (2) Run it in a throwaway branch or sandbox workspace and review the created files under docs/business/ before committing; (3) Check repository for secrets (API keys, credentials) so the agent won't read them inadvertently; (4) Note the skill has no declared homepage or source — if provenance matters, prefer skills from known authors or request more information from the publisher.
